text: Name the five people you talk to most. That list... is your real CV.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Siena... over five hundred years ago. Its lord, Pandolfo Petrucci, had a right-hand man.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Antonio da Venafro. People judged Pandolfo... by him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence, Machiavelli says Pandolfo looked clever... simply for having him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His words... the first opinion which one forms of a prince... is by observing the men he has around him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Then he sorts minds into three kinds.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: One works things out alone. One recognises good ideas from others. One does neither.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His verdict... the first is the most excellent, the second is good, the third is useless.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: So you don't need to be the genius. Spotting good minds... is a power of its own.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Group project. Pick the quiet kid who reads the brief... and you look brilliant on results day.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Now flip it. You're in someone's circle too. Make them look wise.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: This morning, message one person who makes you sharper... and tell them why.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Who's the Venafro in your corner? Tell us what they do for you.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Choose your circle well... and follow Awaaz.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
